text: The type of heterogeneous paths (PathP) in Cubical Type Theory is:
choices: paths between elements of the same type
paths p : P i0 → P i1 over a path of types P: 𝕀 → U
explanation: PathP (path-over-a-path): given P: 𝕀→U, PathP P a b is the type of paths i↦p(i) with p(i):P(i), p(0)≡a, p(1)≡b. This generalises transport and is essential in cubical TT.
